messages:
Leah V.: Dropping a short thread for the reliability/action follow-ups from today's all-hands Q&A. Please keep replies tight so I can compile the exec snapshot. RCA link: https://docs.redwood.com/rcas/INC-3841 

Owen K.: Quick question from product ops: do we have a published TTR target for the incident class? That was asked in the Q&A.

Samir D.: We currently use TTR target = 4h for Sev-2 and 1h for Sev-1. I'll attach the incident playbook snippet to the runbook.

Leah V.: Thanks. Who's the single owner for action tracking and weekly rollups? Need an owner for the exec summary.

Amy L.: I can take the weekly exec snapshot. Leah, can you forward the action register link when it's created?

Samir D.: I'll own the action register creation and initial owners. Planned fields: action, owner, due date, status, blockers. Will post a link in 30m.

Owen K.: For the fallback routing follow-up we promised product a timeline. Propose canary window start: 2026-04-20 09:00 UTC, 48h monitored. Ramp plan: 1% -> 10% -> 25% over 36h if green.

Leah V.: Sounds good. Please state explicit telemetry guards in the runbook so partner teams can wire dashboards.

Samir D.: Telemetry guards (short): sustained 5xx > 0.35% for 10m; p95 latency +18% vs baseline over 10m; Unhandled error spike (>50 errors/min) -> immediate pause. Adding these to the checklist.

Owen K.: Add also "customer-impact flag": if >2 P1 tickets mention the canary tag, pause and engage on-call. Product wants a customer note template ready.

Amy L.: I'll draft a short customer-facing template and drop in the runbook. Keep it neutral and actionable.

Leah V.: On tracing retention: infra estimated cost bump ~4.1k/mo for the proposed 30d extension. Finance sign-off?

Amy L.: Sub-5k is OK via finance liaison, I'll mark it approved once it's on the register.

Samir D.: Ops implementation snippet for the canary engineers:
```
# enable fallback routing in prod-canary
kubectl -n infra apply -f deploy/canaries/fallback-2026-04-20.yaml --context=prod-canary
# ramp steps: 1% -> 10% -> 25%; pause 15m between ramps
```
Also keep request-burst window = 20s for testing.

Incident-bot: Canary scheduled: fallback-2026-04-20 in prod-canary at 2026-04-20T09:00:00Z (build 1289).

Owen K.: Can we also publish a condensed escalation path in the runbook (who to ping at each severity)? Support asked for that during the Q&A.

Samir D.: Will add escalation map: first-line on-call -> infra lead -> product ops -> exec on-call. Also adding explicit Slack channels and phone numbers for P1s.

Leah V.: One more ask: schedule a short sync 24h after canary start to review telemetry and decide on full rollout. Who can own that checkpoint?

Amy L.: I can host the 24h checkpoint. Add it to the canary calendar invite.

Samir D.: Runbook link (draft): https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/fallback-canary-2026-04-20. I'll publish the action register there and tag owners.

Leah V.: Great. I'll consolidate this thread into the master action register and publish the exec snapshot Friday. If anyone hits blockers, DM me. :white_check_mark:
